modelValue.zh-CN: 当前取值，配合 v-model 使用；只传不回写时拖动、点击与方向键仅触发通知，滑块不移动。变回 undefined 时回到 defaultValue，没有则回到 min，且不触发 afterChange。
modelValue.en-US: Current value, used with v-model. When given without a write-back, dragging, clicking and arrow keys only notify and the handle does not move. Back to undefined it returns to defaultValue, or min without one, and afterChange does not fire.

included.zh-CN: marks 不为空对象时有效，true 表示刻度为包含关系，false 表示并列。
included.en-US: Takes effect when marks is not empty. true makes the marks nested, false makes them independent.

marks.zh-CN: 刻度，key 为 number 且取值在闭区间 [min, max] 内，值为字符串或数字；节点内容使用 mark 插槽。
marks.en-US: Marks. Keys are numbers in the closed range [min, max], values are strings or numbers; use the mark slot for node content.

range.zh-CN: 是否支持两端同时可滑动。
range.en-US: Whether both ends can be dragged.

step.zh-CN: 步长，从 min 起计算。

tipFormatter.zh-CN: 设置提示的展示格式，每个手柄单独调用，参数为该手柄的值；默认显示当前取值，null 隐藏提示。
tipFormatter.en-US: Format of the tooltip, called once per handle with that handle's value. Shows the current value by default; null hides the tooltip.

tooltipVisible.en-US: Whether the tooltip is always visible.

tooltipOnMark.en-US: Whether the marks on the rail have a tooltip.

showMarkLabel.en-US: Whether to show the mark labels.

showArrow.en-US: Whether the tooltip has an arrow.

showBoundary.zh-CN: 是否在悬停时展示最大值与最小值。
showBoundary.en-US: Whether to show the maximum and minimum on hover.

verticalReverse.zh-CN: 反转垂直方向，即上大下小。
verticalReverse.en-US: Reverses the vertical direction, so the larger value is on top.

handleDot.zh-CN: 滑块上的圆点，单个滑块传一个对象，range 时按手柄传数组。
handleDot.en-US: Dot on the handle: one object for a single handle, an array with one per handle for a range.

id.zh-CN: 落在第一个手柄的 input 上，用于 label for 关联，点击 label 会聚焦该手柄。
id.en-US: Applied to the first handle's input, so a label for focuses that handle.

ariaLabel.zh-CN: 手柄的可访问名称；range 模式下两个手柄在其后分别追加语言包中的起点、终点。
ariaLabel.en-US: Accessible name of the handle. In range mode, the locale's start and end texts are appended for the two handles.

ariaLabelledby.zh-CN: 引用标签元素的 id，作为手柄的可访问名称；range 模式下每个手柄再加上起点或终点。
ariaLabelledby.en-US: The id of the labelling element, used as the handle's accessible name. In range mode each handle adds its start or end text.

ariaValuetext.zh-CN: 为当前值提供用户友好的名称。
ariaValuetext.en-US: A user-friendly name for the current value.

getAriaValueText.zh-CN: 为当前值提供用户友好的名称，参数为滑块的值与滑块的顺序。
getAriaValueText.en-US: Provides a user-friendly name for the current value, called with the handle's value and its index.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 值变化时触发，供 v-model 回写。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the value changes, for v-model to write back.

change.zh-CN: 值变化时触发，参数为当前取值。
change.en-US: Emitted when the value changes, with the current value.

afterChange.zh-CN: 值变化完成后触发，参数为当前取值；受控值被改回 undefined 时不触发。
afterChange.en-US: Emitted after a change is complete, with the current value. Not emitted when a controlled value goes back to undefined.

mouseUp.zh-CN: 拖动滑块的指针（鼠标、触摸、触控笔）松开或被取消时，以及取值键松开时触发。
mouseUp.en-US: Emitted when the pointer (mouse, touch, pen) dragging a handle is released or cancelled, and when a value key is released.

focus.zh-CN: 任一手柄获得焦点时触发。
focus.en-US: Emitted when any handle receives focus.

blur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个 Slider 时触发，在两个手柄之间切换不触发。
blur.en-US: Emitted when focus leaves the whole Slider; moving between the two handles does not emit it.

mark.zh-CN: 自定义刻度标签，也用于 tooltipOnMark 的提示；作用域参数为刻度的 value 与 label。
mark.en-US: Custom mark label, also used for the tooltipOnMark tooltip. Scoped with the mark's value and label.

tip.zh-CN: 自定义手柄提示的内容；value 为 tipFormatter 的结果，handle 为 min 或 max。
tip.en-US: Custom handle tooltip content. value is the result of tipFormatter and handle is min or max.
